discussion_comments.comment_body:
Hi @jglogan, thanks for taking a look at this! 

The rationale for the change was that `--experimental-maximum-parallelization-width` is an older flag that can sometimes trigger "unknown argument" or deprecation warnings on newer Swift toolchains (Swift 5.10 / Swift 6). I had assumed that `--parallel --num-workers` was the modern, direct replacement for it.

However, if `--experimental-...` is triggering a very specific internal behavior for this project's test harness that `--parallel` lacks, I completely defer to your judgment! 

My only goal was to clean up the integration test commands and remove some of the verbose JSON stream outputs. If you prefer we keep the flags exactly as they are to maintain test stability, just let me know and I am more than happy to close this PR.

+# New integration test infrastructure.
+# PARALLEL_WIDTH controls --experimental-maximum-parallelization-width for the
+# concurrent pass. WARMUP_FILTER, CONCURRENT_FILTER, and GLOBAL_FILTER select

+PARALLEL_WIDTH ?= 2
+WARMUP_FILTER = ImageWarmup
+CONCURRENT_FILTER = DemoConcurrentTests
+GLOBAL_FILTER = DemoGlobalTests
+
+INTEGRATION_SWIFT_EXTRA ?=
+INTEGRATION_POST_TEST ?=
+
+define RUN_INTEGRATION
+	@echo Ensuring apiserver stopped before the CLI integration tests...
+	@bin/container system stop && sleep 3 && scripts/ensure-container-stopped.sh
+	@if [ -n "$(APP_ROOT)" ]; then \
+		echo "Clearing application data under $(APP_ROOT) (preserving kernels)..." ; \
+		mkdir -p $(APP_ROOT) ; \
+		find "$(APP_ROOT)" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name kernels -exec rm -rf {} + ; \
